digest_markdown:
• [1] A supply chain attack on SolarWinds' Orion IT monitoring system, which is used by over 30,000 organizations, was compromised by hackers in September 2019, allowing them to deliver backdoor malware in an Orion software update. [1]
• [1] Approximately 18,000 customers installed the malicious Orion update, allowing the hackers to access and imitate victims' accounts/users, and access system files. [1]
• [2] A supply chain attack targeting GitHub repositories, known as GhostAction, exposed 3,325 secrets, including tokens and keys across widely used platforms. [2]
• [2] The attack was carried out by leveraging compromised maintainer accounts to insert malicious commits into legitimate projects, and exfiltrated sensitive secrets via a curl POST request to a server controlled by the attackers. [2]
• [3] A supply chain attack on the Open VSX registry, which exposed access tokens that granted write access to the registry, allowing unidentified threat actors to publish malicious extensions. [3]
